stable.notes: A Memories tab: what COS learned, what is waiting for review, and your knowledge graph on your own data. Focus on any entity, ask the graph in plain language and get entity cards back, accept or prune a captured memory, set your own guardrails, and merge duplicate people from the Manage sheet with the owner Mac's preview, a worker and a receipt; a Possible duplicates list only proposes. Set up Knowledge from zero with your own embedding choice and extraction tier, and Index now with live progress. Speakers names the meetings it cannot review and why. Pairs with server 6.44.16.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
